newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB to cut July debenture coupon to 2.2% - bankers.
newsitem.headline: LTCB to cut July debenture coupon to 2.2% - bankers.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) will cut the coupon rate for its July five-year bank debentures by 0.2 percentage point to 2.2 percent, bankers said on Wednesday.
LTCB will also cut its July long-term prime rate to 2.7 percent from 2.9 percent in June, they said.
LTCB will officially announce its new long-term prime rate, and the terms for its July five-year bank debentures at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT).
The spread between the coupon rate of LTCB's debentures and the Industrial Bank of Japan's (IBJ) benchmark five-year debentures is expected to remain unchanged from June at 0.4 percentage point.

The IBJ announced on Tuesday that it would cut the coupon rate for its July debentures to 1.8 percent from two percent in June and that it would also cut its new long-term prime rate to 2.7 percent from 2.9 percent previously.
LTCB's June five-year bank debentures with a coupon rate of 2.4 percent were bid at 2.25 percent on Wednesday, bond traders said.
